Final merged evidence and rebar-debug closeout:

Problem: complete real-Pandoc corpus replay was on every Gerrit Verify cell and contributed a measured 184.32-second macOS lower bound, while the contractual target is to retain complete real replay without keeping it in the per-change hot path.

Proven mechanism and proof: the corpus tests repeatedly invoked the production Pandoc subprocess path over the same deterministic inputs. A paired same-host exact-command A/B reduced the focused phase from 42s to 4s (90.8%) when broad assertions consumed committed exact outputs while three representative live bodies remained. The full external replay independently validated 178 bodies, 1,383 real conversions, and 684,843 committed bytes. This rules out mutation selection as the cause of the measured Pandoc phase and proves subprocess replay, not assertion evaluation, was the removable cost.

Fix and coverage safety: Gerrit change 1789, revision 18f58da6241f7ed73c1af3259091e5bcb4682721, merged 2026-08-14T20:57:22Z. Routine Verify retains all corpus assertion classes, every supported Python/OS cell, fail-closed static lookup, provenance/version/argv/stdin/timeout probes, and one live product-path body per code_arrow/table/prose stratum. Weekly/manual External Integration now replays the complete corpus through real Pandoc on Ubuntu and macOS. No production behavior, dependency, OS/Python cell, assertion, skip, or xfail was removed.

Final CI_RESULT={"run_id":"31837971444","status":"passed","duration":1778,"fixes_applied":[],"retry_count":0}. The trusted classifier selected the full non-doc route; Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13 default suites passed, required integration/supporting jobs passed, LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 were cast, and there were no unresolved comments. End-to-end wall time was 29m38s, inside the 20-30m target for this sample. macOS critical path was 27m55s: default suite 23m48s (13,223 passed, 65 skipped in 1,424.78s) plus integration 2m37s (158 passed, 11 skipped in 155.30s). The only individual operation above 30s was 35.09s setup for tests/unit/workflow/test_editor.py::test_server_binds_loopback_only; the repeated CI-only outlier is already recorded on inedible-subsimious-brahmancow.

Patch-set-2 advisory disposition: the suggested missing Pandoc timeout was based on an incorrect premise; the replay calls production wiki_render._convert, which enforces the configured per-operation deadline and reaps the process group. Suggested corrupt-fixture branch tests are non-blocking test-only defensive-path coverage notes; routine tests load the authoritative fixtures fail-closed, and no contractual or behavioral gap was identified.

Replication: the original full non-doc Gerrit scenario completed green at 29m38s, and complete real-Pandoc replay remains in the external suite. Residual risk: one run does not establish an average; ongoing distribution measurement and the editor setup outlier remain owned by inedible-subsimious-brahmancow.
